Session – Oct 23
Call to Session – 2026 State of the Congressional Address – Friday, October 23, 2026, at 5:00 p.m.

I Liheslaturan Guåhan will be called into Friday, October 23, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. The Session will take place in the Speaker Antonio R. Unpingco Legislative Session Hall in the Guam Congress Building for the purpose of conducting the Honorable James C. Moylan, Guam’s Delegate to the United States House of Representatives, 2026 State of the Congressional Address. Congressman Moylan will start his address promptly at 6:00 p.m.
